subject.title: Feature Request: Image batching / media group buffering at gateway layer

question: Should the remaining rapid-media batching behavior be accepted as a LINE-owned opt-in config surface, designed as a broader shared channel/plugin contract, or intentionally left unsupported for channels without native grouping metadata?
rationale: LINE lacks native grouping metadata and the request adds delayed delivery plus new configuration, so automation should not choose the product boundary, default, or heuristic semantics.

options.title: Plugin-owned LINE opt-in batching
options.body: Add a LINE plugin config key with default-off or conservative timing, buffer same account/conversation/sender downloadable media, and document reply-token and latency tradeoffs.

options.title: Shared media batching contract
options.body: Design a channel SDK/core contract for media-aware aggregation before changing LINE, accepting broader architecture and compatibility review.

options.title: Keep heuristic batching unsupported
options.body: Keep Telegram's native media-group handling only and document that LINE users should send combined media/text when no reliable grouping metadata exists.

recommendation.title: Plugin-owned LINE opt-in batching
recommendation.body: Add a LINE plugin config key with default-off or conservative timing, buffer same account/conversation/sender downloadable media, and document reply-token and latency tradeoffs.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses LINE config/docs, shared channel debounce semantics, and plugin-boundary policy where recent path history shows repeated work.
